# Docker/production lock: requirements.lock.txt's exact pins, plus the one
# platform-specific addition (psycopg2-binary) that only needs to resolve inside
# the Linux container, not on every contributor's own machine. Generated by hand
# rather than pip-compile: psycopg2-binary has no manylinux wheel for the Python
# version/platform this repo is developed on, so pip-compile can't resolve it
# locally even though it installs fine inside the python:3.11-slim Docker image
# (see Dockerfile). psycopg2-binary has no sub-dependencies of its own, so this
# is a safe, correct addition rather than a real dependency resolution.
-r requirements.lock.txt
psycopg2-binary==2.9.10
